newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian O/N rates rise then end steady at 21 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian O/N rates rise then end steady at 21 pct.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates rose in brisk trade on Friday as banks replenished their reserves at the end of the current reserve period before falling back as demand subsided.
Overnight rates began at Thursday's closing level of 21.00 percent then rose to 21.75 before dropping again to end at 21.00 percent.
"It was a busy morning," said Erika Kaiser of Budapest Bank. "Heavy demand by banks pushed the rate up to 21.75 and it stayed there until demand fell away before the close."
Dealers expect rates to fall back on Monday now that the banks have fulfilled their reserve needs.
